item.title: A WhatsApp bug lets malicious media files spread through group chats
item.description:

item.title: Data Brokers Can Fuel Violence Against Public Servants
item.description:
📝 Together, this means that information about public employees is uniquely available and that they have uniquely few ways to prevent its dissemination. That analysis found that violent threats against local public servants, including school board members and election workers, represented nearly a third of the reports reviewed. In the past, people seeking out public records would already have to have an idea of where that public record was, and physically go to that location.
🔗 Read more: https://www.wired.com/story/how-data-brokers-can-fuel-violence-against-public-servants/
